About.metaTitle: About us | Wolf Car Auto Services
About.metaDescription: Wolf Car, part of Wolf Group in Qatar: Chinese car specialists serving every make, at Al Gharrafa and Bin Omran and with home service.
About.label: About us
About.title: From Al Gharrafa to Bin Omran, your car is in hands that know it
About.story1: Wolf Car is one of the Wolf Group companies in Qatar. We started in Al Gharrafa Souq as specialists in accessories, parts and programming for Chinese cars, then opened our Bin Omran branch in July 2026, which also offers PPF paint protection and tinting.
About.story2: We specialize in Chinese cars, and we serve every make: protection, tinting, accessories, programming, parts and maintenance, at the branch or at your door.
About.photoBinOmran: The Bin Omran branch at night
About.whySupplyBody: The group has an office and team in China and 3,000 m² of warehouses, so parts reach you faster and at a competitive price.
About.whyToolsBody: We diagnose and program with Launch, Autel, VDS and more.
About.whyTeamBody: Technicians and programmers who specialize in Chinese and electric cars.
About.whyHomeBody: Home service for fitting, tinting and programming, and a free tow to our branch on bills over 1,000 QAR.
About.groupBody: A business group in Qatar of four companies specializing in technology and car services, built on a skilled team and direct supply from China.
About.branchesNote: Choose whichever branch is closer. PPF paint protection and tinting are at Bin Omran.
About.visionBody: To keep growing and improving until we are a leading name everywhere, with services and products that earn our customers' trust and keep up with what they expect next.
About.missionBody: To hold to our values, build long-term relationships with our customers based on trust and respect, and offer the best services and products at prices that suit everyone.
About.partnersBody: Discounts for Imtiaz and Tistahel cardholders, and installments with PayLater.
About.partnerPayLater: 4 installments from 300 QAR, 6 from 6,000 QAR, 12 from 10,000 QAR
About.partnerThabt: An operating partner that extends our service
